mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the absorbing lining was most worthwhile: its folds explained how the gut provides a large surface for nutrients to cross, connecting digestion to the body's supply routes.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early digestion sequence was predictable, with only one combination offered at each step, although the explanations were clear.
